html:
The Yanda were an Aboriginal Australian people of western Queensland, on the map along the Hamilton River country north of today's Boulia.

Almost nothing is recorded about them. Their neighbours were the Yalarrnga, Kalkadoon, Pitta Pitta and Guwa. Cattle stations spread through this area in the 1870s and 1880s.
sum: The Yanda were an Aboriginal Australian people of western Queensland, on the map along the Hamilton River country north of today's Boulia.
